Example: auth plugin with Auth.getProfile, auth.model, main.use(auth), main.get '/profile' access Auth. How to structure dependencies?

Scope lifecycle isolation. Encapsulated within instance. Not shared with other instances. Local default scope applies to instance and descendants. Scoped applies to parent, current, descendants. Global applies to all. Scope casting with 'as' parameter. Guard scope merging. Descendant default behavior. Global hook propagation. Scope table: local/scoped/global per child/current/parent/main.
